name: Salvador Dali
hook: Melting watches, a legendary mustache, and the Surrealist who called his paintings dream photographs.

facts.label: Surrealism
facts.statement: Dali was a Spanish Surrealist who called his works "hand-painted dream photographs"; the movement grew from Dada and de Chirico.

facts.label: The Persistence of Memory
facts.statement: His 1931 The Persistence of Memory sets melting watches on the cliffs of Catalonia; an image in it echoes Bosch's Garden of Earthly Delights.

facts.label: the mustache
facts.statement: Dali was famous for his eccentrically upturned mustache, the subject of a book with photographer Philippe Halsman.

facts.label: the Figueres museum
facts.statement: The Dali Theatre-Museum in his birthplace, Figueres, Spain, is dedicated to the painter and adorned with surreal figures.

facts.label: Luis Bunuel
facts.statement: Dali made two Surrealist films with Luis Bunuel: Un Chien Andalou and L'Age d'Or.

facts.label: Sigmund Freud
facts.statement: Freud inspired the Surrealists but thought them "absolute cranks" until he met Dali in London in 1938.

facts.label: St. Petersburg, Florida
facts.statement: A magnificent museum devoted to Dali stands in St. Petersburg, Florida.
